title: String Plugin
description: A simple Minecraft plugin that adds the /string command, letting players fill empty inventory slots with stacks of string. The command has a configurable cooldown, set to 30 seconds by default, to prevent spam. Works with Spigot/Paper servers
body:
A simple Minecraft plugin that adds the /string command, letting players fill empty inventory slots with stacks of string. The command has a configurable cooldown, set to  60 seconds by default, to prevent spam. Works with Spigot/Paper servers using Minecraft 1.21+

Cooldown can be changed via plugin Yml
